answer: In this PoA design, reputation follows an exponential temporal half-life, requiring sustained, honestly validated service to retain weight. EigenTrust matrix factorization gives freshly spawned Sybil identities near-zero eigenvector centrality because they lack trusted incoming mass. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity rejects manufactured endorsements, so identity splitting cannot pass consensus; unrelated signals such as marble, wander, or sonnet add no influence without durable attestations.
